content.value_statement: NFT projects need correct token standards, metadata, and marketplace behavior. This skill guides ERC-721 and ERC-1155 implementation with practical contract patterns.
actual_capabilities: Explains when to use ERC-721 for unique tokens and ERC-1155 for multi-token assets.
Provides Solidity examples for minting, burning, supply limits, and token URI handling.
Shows off-chain and on-chain metadata patterns, including traits and base64 metadata.
Covers EIP-2981 royalty support for marketplace compatibility.
Includes patterns for soulbound tokens, dynamic NFTs, and ERC721A batch minting.
limitations: Examples are educational and require review before production deployment.
It does not audit deployed contracts or verify bytecode.
It does not handle chain-specific deployment configuration.
Referenced resource files are listed, but only SKILL.md is present in this package.

use_cases.title: Launch an NFT Collection
use_cases.description: Design an ERC-721 contract with mint limits, token URIs, withdrawal logic, and marketplace-ready metadata.

use_cases.title: Build Game Assets
use_cases.description: Use ERC-1155 patterns for fungible and non-fungible game items with supply controls and batch minting.

use_cases.title: Add Marketplace Features
use_cases.description: Plan royalties, metadata compatibility, token enumeration, and gas-aware minting for common marketplace workflows.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Standard
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me choose ERC-721 or ERC-1155 for my NFT project. Compare fit, tradeoffs, and metadata needs.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Minting Contract
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an ERC-721 minting plan with max supply, per-wallet limits, payment checks, token URI handling, and owner withdrawal.

prompt_templates.title: Design Metadata
prompt_templates.prompt: Design off-chain and on-chain metadata for my NFT collection. Include traits, image handling, reveal strategy, and marketplace compatibility checks.

prompt_templates.title: Review Advanced Features
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my NFT architecture for royalties, soulbound behavior, dynamic metadata, ERC721A minting, and ERC-1155 batch operations. Identify risks and fixes.

output_examples.input: I need a 10,000 item profile picture collection with paid minting.
output_examples.output: A concise ERC-721 implementation plan with supply limits, mint price checks, metadata URI strategy, and marketplace compatibility notes.

output_examples.input: I need weapons, badges, and consumables for a blockchain game.
output_examples.output: An ERC-1155 design that separates token IDs, max supplies, mint permissions, batch minting, and burn behavior.

output_examples.input: I want royalties and evolving NFT traits.
output_examples.output: A feature checklist covering EIP-2981 royalties, dynamic token state, metadata updates, and ownership-based update permissions.

best_practices: Use audited OpenZeppelin contracts as the base implementation.
Pin metadata to durable storage and test marketplace rendering early.
Review minting, withdrawal, royalty, and transfer logic before deployment.
anti_patterns: Do not deploy sample contracts without adapting access control and tests.
Do not store mutable metadata without a clear update and reveal policy.
Do not assume every marketplace enforces royalties in the same way.

faq.question: Does this skill generate production-ready contracts?
faq.answer: It provides implementation patterns and examples. Production contracts still need testing, review, and deployment planning.

faq.question: When should I use ERC-721?
faq.answer: Use ERC-721 when each token is unique and needs individual ownership and metadata.

faq.question: When should I use ERC-1155?
faq.answer: Use ERC-1155 for collections with many token types, batch transfers, or mixed fungible and non-fungible assets.

faq.question: Does it cover NFT metadata?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers IPFS metadata, trait attributes, on-chain metadata, and marketplace rendering concerns.

faq.question: Does it include royalty guidance?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes EIP-2981 royalty patterns and basic marketplace compatibility considerations.

faq.question: Can it audit my contract?
faq.answer: It can guide manual review, but it is not a replacement for a formal smart contract audit.
